init.repoIntro: Snorkeling is a personalized customization project based on Wave Terminal upstream.
init.communityIntro: Get help, submit feature requests, report bugs, or just chat with fellow terminal enthusiasts.
init.telemetryIntro: Anonymous usage data helps us improve features you use.

noTelemetryStar.title: Telemetry Disabled ✓
noTelemetryStar.introLine1: No problem, we respect your privacy.
noTelemetryStar.introLine2: Snorkeling is a customized project based on Wave Terminal. If this customization is useful, starring the Snorkeling repository helps us keep maintaining it.

waveai.title: Wave AI
waveai.intro: Wave AI is your terminal assistant with context. I can read your terminal output, analyze widgets, read/write files, and help you solve problems faster.
waveai.toggleWithButton: Toggle the Wave AI panel with the <AiButton /> button in the header (top left)
waveai.shortcutIntro: Or use the keyboard shortcut <Shortcut /> to quickly toggle
waveai.apiKeyIntro: Bring your own API keys or run local models with Ollama, LM Studio, and other OpenAI-compatible providers

magnify.title: Magnify Blocks
magnify.intro1: Magnify any block to focus on what matters. Expand terminals, editors, and previews for a better view.
magnify.intro2: Use the magnify feature to work with complex outputs and large files more efficiently.
magnify.iconHint: You can also magnify a block by clicking on the <Icon /> icon in the block header.
magnify.shortcutHint: A quick <Shortcut /> to magnify and another <Shortcut /> to unmagnify

files.title: Viewing/Editing Files
files.intro: Wave can preview markdown, images, and video files on both local <Italic>and remote</Italic> machines.
files.viewHint: Use wsh view [filename] to preview files in Wave's graphical viewer
files.editHint: Use wsh edit [filename] to open config files or code files in Wave's graphical editor
files.remoteSummary: These commands work seamlessly on both local and remote machines, making it easy to view and edit files wherever they are.

durable.title: Durable SSH Sessions
durable.subtitle: SSH Sessions, Protected
durable.intro: Close your laptop, switch networks, restart Wave — your remote sessions keep running.
durable.preserve: Shell state, running programs, and terminal history are all preserved
durable.reconnect: Sessions automatically reconnect when your connection is restored
durable.buffer: Buffered output streams back in, never miss a line
durable.footnote: All the persistence of tmux, built into your terminal. Look for the shield icon to enable durability on any SSH session.

starAsk.title: Support open-source. Star Snorkeling. ⭐
starAsk.intro: Snorkeling is a custom project built on top of Wave Terminal upstream.
starAsk.intro2: If this customization is useful for your workflow, please star the Snorkeling repository.

upgradeMinor.title: Welcome to Wave v0.14!
upgradeMinor.intro1: Wave AI is your terminal assistant with full context. It can read your terminal output, analyze widgets, read and write files, and help you solve problems faster.
upgradeMinor.newInV013Detail: Wave AI now supports local models and bring-your-own-key! Use Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible provider.
upgradeMinor.newInV014Detail: Durable SSH sessions survive network drops, laptop sleep, and restarts — all without tmux or screen.
upgradeMinor.thanksLine: Thanks for being an early Wave adopter! ⭐
upgradeMinor.starPitch: A GitHub star shows your support for Wave (and open-source) and helps us reach more developers.

upgradeV0121.intro: Patch release focused on shell integration improvements, Wave AI enhancements, and restoring syntax highlighting in code editor blocks.
upgradeV0121.osc7Desc: - Wave now automatically tracks and restores your current directory across restarts for bash, zsh, fish, and pwsh shells
upgradeV0121.shellContextDesc: - Tracks when your shell is ready, last command executed, and exit codes for better terminal management
upgradeV0121.aiItem1: Display reasoning summaries while waiting for AI responses
upgradeV0121.aiItem2: Enhanced terminal context - AI now has access to shell state, current directory, command history, and exit codes
upgradeV0121.aiItem3: Added feedback buttons (thumbs up/down) for AI responses
upgradeV0121.aiItem4: Added copy button to easily copy AI responses to clipboard
upgradeV0121.otherItem1: Mobile user agent emulation support for web widgets
upgradeV0121.otherItem2: Fixed padding for header buttons in code editor
upgradeV0121.otherItem3: Restored syntax highlighting in code editor preview blocks

upgradeV0122.intro: Wave AI can now create and modify files with visual diff previews and easy rollback capabilities. Plus performance improvements and bug fixes.
upgradeV0122.fileWriteDesc: - Wave AI can now create and modify files with your approval
upgradeV0122.visualDiffDesc: - See exactly what will change before approving edits
upgradeV0122.rollbackDesc: - Revert file changes with a simple "Revert File" button
upgradeV0122.aiItem1: Drag & drop files from preview viewer directly to Wave AI
upgradeV0122.aiItem3: Adjustable thinking level and max output tokens per chat
upgradeV0122.aiItem4: Improved tool descriptions and input validations
upgradeV0122.bugfixItem1: Fixed significant memory leak in the RPC system

upgradeV0123.intro: Wave AI model upgrade to GPT-5.1, new secret management features, and improved terminal input handling for interactive CLI tools.
upgradeV0123.gptDesc: - Upgraded to OpenAI's GPT-5.1 model for improved responses
upgradeV0123.thinkingDesc: - New dropdown to select between Quick, Balanced, and Deep thinking modes
upgradeV0123.aiFix: Fixed path mismatch issue when restoring AI write file backups
upgradeV0123.inputDesc: - Better support for CLI tools like Claude Code
upgradeV0123.imagePasteDesc: - Paste images directly into terminal (saved to temp files)
upgradeV0123.multilineItem: Shift+Enter now inserts newlines by default for multi-line commands
upgradeV0123.imeItem: Fixed duplicate text issue when switching input methods (IME)
upgradeV0123.secretWidgetDesc: - Store and manage sensitive credentials securely

upgradeV0130.intro: Wave v0.13 brings local AI support, bring-your-own-key (BYOK), a redesigned configuration system, and improved terminal functionality.
upgradeV0130.openaiCompatDesc: - Connect to Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenRouter, and other local or hosted models
upgradeV0130.presetsDesc: - Built-in configs for OpenAI, OpenRouter, Google, Azure, and custom endpoints
upgradeV0130.modesDesc: - Easily switch between models and providers
upgradeV0130.newConfigDesc: - Dedicated widget accessible from the sidebar
upgradeV0130.organizationDesc: - Browse and edit settings with improved validation and error handling
upgradeV0130.secretsDesc: - Manage API keys and credentials from the config widget
upgradeV0130.bracketedPasteDesc: - Enabled by default for better multi-line paste behavior
upgradeV0130.windowsPasteDesc: - Ctrl+V now works as standard paste on Windows
upgradeV0130.sshPasswordDesc: - Store SSH passwords in Wave's secret store

upgradeV0131.intro: Wave v0.13.1 focuses on Windows platform improvements, Wave AI visual updates, and enhanced terminal navigation.
upgradeV0131.windowLayoutDesc: - Cleaner interface with controls integrated into the tab-bar header
upgradeV0131.sshAgentDesc: - Improved SSH agent support on Windows
upgradeV0131.focusKeyDesc: - Wave AI focus key changed to Alt:0 on Windows
upgradeV0131.visualDesignDesc: - Complete UI refresh with transparency support for custom backgrounds
upgradeV0131.byokDesc: - Wave AI now works with bring-your-own-key and local models without requiring telemetry
upgradeV0131.scrollKeysDesc: - Added Shift+Home, Shift+End, Shift+PageUp, and Shift+PageDown for better navigation

upgradeV0140.intro: Wave v0.14 introduces Durable Sessions. Enable them to keep your remote sessions alive through network interruptions, computer sleep, and restarts — they'll automatically reconnect when your connection is restored.
upgradeV0140.protectionDesc: - Programs and shell state survive disconnects
upgradeV0140.stopDesc: - Ability to stop AI responses mid-generation
upgradeV0140.contextMenuDesc: - Quick access to splits, themes, and more
upgradeV0140.osc52Desc: - CLI apps can copy to system clipboard

upgradeV0141.intro: Wave v0.14.1 fixes several high-impact terminal bugs and adds new config options for focus, cursor style, and block navigation.
upgradeV0141.imeDesc: - Fixed Korean/CJK input losing or sticking characters
upgradeV0141.scrollResizeDesc: - Terminal stays at bottom across resizes
upgradeV0141.scrollbackAfter: command to save scrollback to a file
upgradeV0141.cursorStyleDesc: - Configure cursor shape and blink per-block
upgradeV0141.providersDesc: - Added Groq and NanoGPT as built-in presets

upgradeV0142.intro: Wave v0.14.2 introduces a new block badge system for at-a-glance status, along with directory preview improvements and bug fixes. v0.14.3 is a patch release fixing a showstopper bug in onboarding.
upgradeV0142.rollUpTitle: Block Badges Roll Up to Tabs
upgradeV0142.rollUpDesc: - Blocks can display icon badges (with color and priority) that are visible in the tab bar for at-a-glance status
upgradeV0142.bellBefore: - Terminal bell badge now lights up the block and tab when your terminal rings (controlled by
upgradeV0142.wshBadgeDesc: - New command to set or clear badges from the CLI. Supports icons, colors, priorities, and PID-linked badges
upgradeV0142.claudeAfter: with Claude Code hooks to surface AI task status as tab bar notifications
upgradeV0142.directoryDesc: - Improved mod time formatting, zebra-striped rows, better default sort, and YAML file support
upgradeV0142.gnomeFix: [bugfix] Fixed "New Window" hanging on GNOME desktops
upgradeV0142.saveSessionFix: [bugfix] Fixed "Save Session As..." focused window tracking bug

upgradeV0144.intro: Wave v0.14.4 introduces vertical tabs, upgrades to xterm.js v6, and includes bug fixes and UI improvements.
upgradeV0144.newVerticalDesc: - Tabs can now be displayed vertically along the side of the window for more horizontal space. Toggle between horizontal and vertical layouts in settings.
upgradeV0144.xtermDesc: - Improved terminal compatibility and rendering, resolving quirks with tools like Claude Code
upgradeV0144.macosDesc: - First click now focuses the clicked widget
upgradeV0144.configErrorsDesc: - Config errors to the WaveConfig view for less clutter
upgradeV0144.unsavedItem: WaveConfig now warns on Unsaved Changes
upgradeV0144.legacyAiItem: Deprecated legacy AI widget has been removed
upgradeV0144.focusFix: [bugfix] Fixed focus bug for newly created blocks

upgradeV0145.intro: Wave v0.14.5 introduces a new Process Viewer widget, several quality-of-life improvements, and a fix for creating new config files from the Settings widget.
upgradeV0145.processViewerDesc: New widget that displays running processes on local and remote machines, with CPU and memory usage and sortable columns.
upgradeV0145.quakeAfter: ) now toggles a Wave window visible and invisible
upgradeV0145.splitButtonsAfter: setting adds split buttons to block headers
upgradeV0145.sidebarItem: Toggle the widgets sidebar on and off from the View menu
upgradeV0145.renameTabItem: F2 to rename the active tab
upgradeV0145.mouseNavItem: Mouse back/forward buttons now navigate in web widgets
upgradeV0145.bugfixDesc: Config files that didn't exist yet couldn't be created or edited from the Settings widget
